summary: Frontend-only verification of the 4 Lisa tweaks (barge-in checkbox+keyword, command hints chips, voice confirmations with result count, row read-out) plus regressions for nav/pagination/reset/unknown-chat. All 7 review scenarios pass end-to-end via the popup text input and hint chips.

test_results.barge_in_settings: PASS - lisa-autointerrupt-checkbox is checked by default; keyword input hidden. Unchecking reveals lisa-interrupt-keyword with default value 'hold on', editable to 'stop please'. Re-checking hides it. No crash.
test_results.command_hints: PASS - lisa-hints contains all 6 chips ['Show delivered orders','Go to Items Search','Electronics in stock','Read the top order','Next page','Reset filters']. Clicking lisa-hint-show-delivered-orders filtered table to Delivered (10 visible rows) and transcript said 'Showing Delivered orders. That's 186 matching orders.'
test_results.voice_confirmations: PASS - 'show delivered orders' -> 'Showing Delivered orders. That's 186 matching orders.' 'reset filters' -> 'Cleared all filters on orders. That's 1,000 matching orders.'
test_results.row_read_out_orders: PASS - 'read the top order' -> 'Order ORD-100170 for James Smith. Status Delivered, High priority, paid. Amount 4727 dollars, region Europe.' 'read the second order' -> ORD-100372 Mason Miller details.
test_results.row_read_out_items: PASS - after 'go to Items Search', 'read the top item' -> 'Pro Yoga Mat, SKU SKU-200930. Category Sports, condition Used. 442 in stock, priced at 707 dollars, supplied by Globex.'
test_results.navigation: PASS - 'go to Items Search' -> /items; 'navigate to order search' -> /orders; popup persists both ways.
test_results.pagination: PASS - 'next page' and 'previous page' both processed. Transcript said 'Going to the next/previous page. That's 1,000 matching orders.' (total count, not the 11-20 range mentioned in the review request but matches the implemented describeSearch+count behavior).
test_results.unknown_chat_regression: PASS - 'what is the weather' with Foundry unconfigured returns graceful 503 message: 'The Foundry agent isn't configured yet. Add the FOUNDRY_* environment variables...' No crash; console shows the expected 503.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor UX: for pagination commands, runSearchWithCount appends 'That's 1,000 matching orders' (total) rather than a 'Showing 11-20' range. Consider using data.page_size + current page to phrase the range if that copy is preferred.
voiceCommands.js line 109 regex '(previous|prev|last) page' also treats 'last page' as previous — likely unintended; 'last page' probably should jump to the final page.
handleUtterance keyword regex uses `new RegExp(kw, 'i')` without escaping user input — a keyword containing regex metacharacters could throw. Wrap with an escapeRegExp helper.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Lisa popup tweaks (auto-interrupt checkbox, keyword input, hints chips, voice confirmations with counts, order/item row read-out, navigation, pagination, reset, graceful 503 for unknown chat) verified via lisa-text-input and lisa-hint-* selectors on the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Live audio/barge-in cannot be automated but the UI wiring behind autoInterruptRef/interruptKeywordRef was reviewed in code.
